newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post front page - April 22.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post front page - April 22.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following stories on its front page on April 22:

WASHINGTON - The Supreme Court closed off an important avenue of appeal for American universities and colleges that provide more sports programs for men than women based on their belief that female students are less interested in athletics.
WASHINGTON - Critics of environmental education say children are being "scared green" by textbooks and the mass media.
WASHINGTON - Retail magnate Herbert Haft agreed to accept a $42 million cash buyout to give up control of the Dart Group Corp. retail empire.
GRAND FORKS, NORTH DAKOTA - The last residents fled Grand Forks and the city may remain unlivable for two to three weeks.
NEW DELHI - I.K. Gujral was sworn in as India's prime minister, signaling a sea change in Indian politics.
